problem: Loopbreaker's shape gate lets an agent author the premise itself with almost no human input (the shape-strategy skill explicitly says do not conduct an exhaustive interview and batch at most four questions). A premise the agent invents rather than derives from a human is then faithfully propagated and hardened by every downstream gate, so a wrong premise becomes rigorously certified wrong software. LB-20 demonstrated it: success_signal promised tailnet reachability no human requested, and the review's own rigor turned it into a mandatory enforced behavior. A naive attestation gate does not fix this: if the record only checks that an answer is present and the attester is a caller-supplied string, an in-session agent can write its own answers, name the founder, and certify its own premise as founder-backed - the same false assurance in a new place.
appetite: A larger campaign: the structural fix the whole session pointed to, funded as a multi-slice initiative and delivered slice by slice.
smallest_slice: A field-isomorphic shape gate backed by a durable founder-issued attestation primitive. Each required shape field must equal an answer that provably originated from the founder through a channel the in-session agent does not mediate (a hil_ask-style durable request that parks until answered out-of-band, its origin validated by LB-21 ingress provenance). A shape value that diverges from its attested answer, or an answer that did not originate from the founder, is refused by name.
non_goals: Initiative and epic level scoping of the gate, which depends on LB-23 tiers being implemented (a later slice)
Multi-party attestation; this slice is founder-only
Authoring the grill-me-style relentless interview experience itself; this slice builds the gate and the durable attestation primitive, not the interview UX

Cryptographic hardening of the local provenance channel against an agent that exfiltrates a one-time token from outside its session; the threat model here is an honest founder and a bounded in-session agent (a named residual risk)
Retroactively blocking already-shaped issues (LB-14 through LB-24 are grandfathered)
success_signal: A shape reaches proceed only when every required shape field (problem, appetite, smallest_slice, non_goals, success_signal, reversibility, decision_owner, risks) equals a recorded answer that provably originated from the founder via the durable attestation primitive. A self-asserted or agent-ingress attester, or a shape value diverging from its attested answer, is refused by name; supplying a valid founder-issued answer that matches unblocks exactly that field.
reversibility: The discovery requirement is an additive gate controlled by one default-on switch. Disabling it makes the shape gate behave exactly as today, leaves the discovery and attestation tables inert, and never reclassifies any issue's grandfather cohort. No data loss.

risks.risk: Local provenance is not cryptographically hard: an in-session agent that exfiltrates the one-time token could forge a founder-issued answer.
risks.mitigation: The token is delivered through a channel outside the agent's session (the served web UI or the founder's terminal), and origin is cross-checked against LB-21 ingress provenance so an mcp/cli agent ingress is refused. Hardening beyond token-plus-ingress is an explicit non-goal of this slice.

risks.risk: Pulling the durable primitive into the first slice makes it larger and adds a hard dependency on LB-21 provenance stamping.
risks.mitigation: The review showed attestation without provenance is defeatable, so the primitive is load-bearing, not gold-plating; LB-21 is already planned and admitted, and this slice names it as a prerequisite.

risks.risk: The gate degrades into rote box-ticking.
risks.mitigation: Field-isomorphism forces a distinct founder-issued answer per shape field, and value-binding means a blanket sign-off that does not match the shape values cannot satisfy it.
